name: Newegg (US)
warning: Every field below marked `unverified` is a hypothesis. Do not compose a search URL from this file and trust the result set. Derive it properly first — the five-step recipe is in profiles/README.md — then replace this block with `verified` and `verified_how`.
why_it_exists: Newegg is the second tech marketplace in regular use alongside Amazon. Stubbed now so the slot and its shape are recorded; the bias of this profile set is deliberately tech-heavy and is expected to stay that way.

identifier.format: unverified — Newegg item numbers are commonly seen as N82E16800000000
identifier.rule: Quote the item number and the direct product URL in recommendations, same principle as ASIN on Amazon.

search.filter_param: unverified — Newegg uses N= category/facet node codes rather than Amazon's rh= grammar
search.note: Newegg's facet encoding is structurally different from Amazon's. Do not assume the Amazon grammar transfers.

filters._todo: Derive the manufacturer/brand facet first — it is the field that carries the value, per the Amazon profile's trust_rubric. Then delivery speed, seller (Newegg vs Marketplace), price band, rating.

seller_model.note: Newegg has the same first-party vs marketplace-seller split as Amazon, so the Amazon trust_rubric axis transfers in principle. The equivalent of p_6:ATVPDKIKX0DER — a 'sold by Newegg' filter — is the highest-value token to find. UNVERIFIED.

trust_rubric.note: The structural signals carry over — first-party vs marketplace seller, brand existence off-platform, listing age over review text. Newegg-specific additions (open-box grading, refurb tiers, its own return-policy tiers) still to be captured.

fetch_route.secondary: geo-egress fetch_markdown with egress=us — UNTESTED against this host
fetch_route.never: any cloud fetcher without a US exit

prior_art.source: Claude-Purchasing-Plugin scripts/price_scan.py SITE_PRICE_RES['newegg'] — this one IS verified working and is the single piece of real knowledge carried into this stub.
prior_art.bot_protection: Newegg sits behind bot protection; blocked responses are expected and normal per the `procurement-tools` plugin's price-scan skill.

traps: Newegg quotes shipping at the cart rather than on the product page, so a product-page scrape cannot produce a landed cost.
Bot protection is active — expect blocked fetches rather than treating them as an outage.
